description: This file is a shell script for testing 'git svn' operations with repositories containing branch names that have special or funky characters, such as spaces, dots, and encoded characters. It sets up SVN repositories with such branch names, clones them using 'git svn', and performs dcommit operations to ensure proper handling of these branch names.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case with a description; runs commands to set up repositories or test functionalities as specified.

methods.name: svn_cmd
methods.description: A utility or function used to execute SVN commands within the script, such as import, copy, and listing.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for prerequisites before running certain tests, e.g., whether building on MinGW.

methods.name: maybe_start_httpd
methods.description: Starts an HTTP daemon if necessary for testing remote SVN operations.
